name: Subscriptions for WooCommerce by Sublium
author: FunnelKit

sections.description:
Sublium Subscriptions is a WooCommerce subscriptions plugin that helps you sell recurring products, memberships, service plans, and installment payments. Create subscription products, automate renewals, collect recurring payments, reduce churn, and let customers manage their own plans.

Built for store owners, marketers, and growing brands, Sublium Subscriptions combines subscription billing, failed payment recovery, cancellation prevention, customer self-service, and subscription analytics in one WooCommerce solution.

Instead of stitching together multiple tools, use one subscription system to launch, manage, and grow recurring revenue in WooCommerce.

Sublium Subscriptions includes built-in retention tools that help you keep subscribers longer with pause and skip options, smart cancellation flows, automated payment recovery, and customer self-service.

Sublium Subscriptions Pro

Sublium Subscriptions Pro adds zero additional transaction fees, advanced retention workflows, a built-in analytics dashboard, smart cancellation flows, a one-click card updater, upgrade groups, and a visual email builder. Get Sublium Subscriptions Pro now.

Watch this video to learn why WooCommerce store owners, marketers, developers, and subscription businesses choose Sublium Subscriptions:

What You Can Do With Sublium Subscriptions

  • Create WooCommerce subscription products in minutes
  • Offer recurring payments and automatic renewals
  • Launch installment payment plans for high-ticket products
  • Sell physical products, digital memberships, and service subscriptions
  • Let customers pause, skip, reschedule, or restart plans
  • Recover failed payments automatically
  • Track subscriber growth, MRR, ARR, churn, and renewal performance

WooCommerce Subscription Features

  • Create simple and variable subscription products
  • Support recurring billing and automatic renewals
  • Offer free trials and one-time signup fees
  • Manage fixed-term and evergreen subscriptions
  • Handle upgrades, downgrades, and proration
  • Provide customer self-service inside WooCommerce
  • Recover failed renewals automatically
  • Track subscription analytics and subscriber growth
  • Create installment plans and scheduled payment products

Why Store Owners Choose Sublium for WooCommerce Subscriptions

Most WooCommerce subscription plugins stop at billing. Sublium Subscriptions goes further with built-in retention, failed payment recovery, customer self-service, and revenue tracking.

5-Minute Setup Wizard

Launch your first subscription product in minutes with a guided setup wizard. No complicated configuration required.

Easy Subscription Management

If you can create a standard WooCommerce product, you can create and manage subscriptions with Sublium Subscriptions.

Flexible Subscription Models

Support physical subscribe-and-save products, digital memberships, service retainers, and installment payment plans.

Failed Payment Recovery for Recurring Orders

Automatically retry failed payments with intelligent scheduling. Send card expiry reminders and let customers update cards with one secure link.

Churn Reduction Tools

Let subscribers pause, skip, reschedule, or restart plans. Use cancellation flows, surveys, and retention offers to reduce churn.

Customer Self-Service Portal

Reduce support tickets by letting subscribers manage their own subscriptions, shipping details, renewals, and payment methods.

Subscription Analytics Dashboard

Track MRR, ARR, churn, subscriber trends, cohort performance, renewal performance, and revenue forecasts from one dashboard.

Upgrade and Downgrade Offers

Create plan hierarchies, offer upgrade incentives, handle proration automatically, and trigger upgrade prompts at the right time.

One-Click Card Updater

Recover revenue lost to expired cards with secure one-time update links. Customers can update payment methods without logging in.

Visual Email Builder

Design professional subscription emails with a drag-and-drop builder and dynamic merge tags.

Subscription Features for Physical Products, Memberships, and Installments

Subscribe and Save for Physical Products

Offer automatic deliveries for consumables, flexible delivery cycles, subscriber discounts, and renewal-based forecasting.

Recurring Digital Subscriptions

Automate billing for memberships, courses, and services. Restrict premium access behind recurring payments and revoke access automatically when payments fail.

Installment Payment Plans

Split high-ticket purchases into weekly or monthly payments. Collect upfront down payments, allow early payoff, and reduce cart abandonment.

Flexible Billing Options

Set custom billing intervals such as daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly, and define fixed-term or evergreen subscriptions.

Free Trials

Offer free trial periods with control over trial length, billing start date, and post-trial renewals.

One-Time Signup Fees

Charge a one-time setup or onboarding fee in addition to recurring subscription payments.

Advanced Subscription Coupons

Create recurring percentage or fixed discounts, usage limits, expiry dates, and promotion-based subscription offers.

Payment Gateway Support

Accept payments via Stripe for automatic renewals, Square, PayPal, major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay with secure tokenization.

Automated Email Notifications

Send welcome emails, renewal receipts, failed renewal alerts, cancellation confirmations, installment notifications, and admin alerts for key events.

Smart Cancellation Flows

Present benefit reminders before cancellation, collect feedback, show retention offers, and display final win-back options.

Activity Logs

Track subscription events, renewal processing, event triggers, timestamps, filtering, and CSV exports for audits and troubleshooting.

Lightweight Performance

Sublium Subscriptions is built to stay efficient for WooCommerce stores while handling recurring billing workflows.

Auto-Calculated Proration

Automatically calculate fair billing adjustments when customers upgrade or downgrade mid-cycle.

Unlimited Subscription Growth

Create unlimited subscriptions, accept unlimited subscribers, and scale recurring revenue without artificial limits.

Ideal Use Cases for Sublium Subscriptions

Sublium Subscriptions works well for stores and businesses selling:

  • Subscribe and save products
  • Monthly product boxes
  • Digital memberships
  • Online courses with recurring billing
  • Coaching and service retainers
  • Refill and replenishment products
  • Installment plans for expensive products
  • Ongoing maintenance or support plans
  • Recurring wellness or lifestyle products

Switching to Sublium Subscriptions

Sublium Subscriptions is built for WooCommerce store owners who want a simpler subscription setup with recurring billing, retention tools, failed payment recovery, and analytics in one place.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Sublium”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Sublium Subscriptions plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

After Activation

  1. Navigate to the Sublium Subscriptions settings screen
  2. Configure your subscription settings
  3. Connect your payment gateway
  4. Create your first subscription product
  5. Start accepting recurring payments
sections.faq:
What is Sublium Subscriptions and how does it work?

Sublium is the brand, and Sublium Subscriptions is its WooCommerce subscription management product. It lets you turn WooCommerce products into subscription products, automate renewals, manage customers, and track subscription performance from one dashboard.

How do I add subscriptions to WooCommerce?

Install Sublium Subscriptions, activate it, connect your payment gateway, and configure a WooCommerce product as a subscription or installment plan using the plugin settings.

How do recurring payments work in WooCommerce?

Sublium Subscriptions schedules renewals automatically, charges supported saved payment methods through compatible gateways, records renewal activity, and notifies customers about key subscription events.

Can I create installment payment plans in WooCommerce?

Yes. Sublium Subscriptions supports installment payment plans so you can split purchases into scheduled payments while keeping the customer experience inside WooCommerce.

Can customers pause or skip subscriptions in WooCommerce?

Yes. Sublium Subscriptions includes customer self-service tools that let subscribers pause, skip, reschedule, restart, or manage key aspects of their subscriptions.

Which payment gateways support recurring payments?

Sublium Subscriptions supports Stripe for automatic recurring payments, along with Square, PayPal, major cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay depending on your setup.

Does Sublium Subscriptions handle failed payments automatically?

Yes. Sublium Subscriptions includes built-in dunning and failed payment recovery with retry scheduling, reminder emails, and customer card update workflows.

How are subscription upgrades and downgrades handled?

Sublium Subscriptions automatically handles plan changes and prorates charges when customers upgrade or downgrade, helping keep billing fair and predictable.

Can I sell memberships and regular products together?

Yes. Customers can buy Sublium Subscriptions products and regular WooCommerce products in the same checkout.

Will Sublium Subscriptions work with my WordPress theme?

Yes. Sublium Subscriptions is built to WooCommerce standards and is designed to work smoothly with most well-coded themes.

Does Sublium Subscriptions support variable products and multiple plans?

Yes. You can create variable subscription products in Sublium Subscriptions and offer monthly, quarterly, yearly, or custom billing options.

Does Sublium Subscriptions work with WPML for multilingual stores?

Yes. Sublium Subscriptions is compatible with WPML for multilingual WooCommerce subscription stores.

Can I migrate from another WooCommerce subscription plugin?

Sublium Subscriptions is designed for store owners who want a simpler recurring billing stack. If you are moving from another setup, review your existing product, customer, and renewal workflows first, then map them into the Sublium Subscriptions structure.

Are there limits on subscriptions or subscribers?

No. With Sublium Subscriptions, you can create unlimited subscriptions and serve unlimited subscribers.

Is Sublium Subscriptions GDPR compliant?

Sublium Subscriptions follows GDPR-friendly practices and supports data export and deletion requests through WordPress and WooCommerce workflows.

What reports can I generate?

Sublium Subscriptions can report on recurring revenue, subscriber growth, churn, payment success, subscription status, MRR, ARR, and other subscription trends.

How does Sublium Subscriptions handle taxes?

Sublium Subscriptions integrates with WooCommerce tax settings so taxes can be calculated on subscriptions and renewals based on your store rules.

Need help setting things up?

Our Support Team is ready to help you launch and grow your subscription business.
